issues.issue: Do the claimants face a forward-looking risk from militias in Colombia?
issues.applicant_position: Militias keep calling to recruit him, even after 10 years abroad; mother still receives calls.
issues.result_text: Claimant's allegation of ongoing recruitment is implausible and undermines his credibility.

issues.issue: Is Bogota a viable internal flight alternative?
issues.applicant_position: Militia authors could find them anywhere in Colombia; relocation would be unreasonable.
issues.result_text: Claimants did not discharge burden; they have an internal flight alternative in Bogota.
